summary: Units 1-50 (50 units, 8.4.1-50) reviewed against the Sanskrit; 19 units flagged, 67 issues: 16 errors, 51 minor; all patched. Tokens, splits and sandhi match the e-text throughout; compound analysis is sound. All ten text_flags are confirmed (3 na-it, 13 praiyoddhum, 16 prakṛiti, 34 '..', 41 ahapāriṇaḥ/dṛsyāś, 43 aparahanti, 48 vargah are certain; 41 pratyantara->pratyanta and 43 yodino->yodhino are rightly marked 'possible' and should stay so).
